<div class="container pagewrap npadr">
	<div class="col-xs-12 contentcol" style="padding-top: 30px;">
		<h1>Beekite</h1>
		<div class="pagecontent">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We have been in Praia do Macapa Kitesurf Spot for almost 10 years. Due to the exceptionally beautiful and varied spot, Praia do Macapa Brazil is enjoying increasing popularity in the kite world year after year.</p>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-kitesurfing-brazil-for-family">Kitesurfing Brazil for Family</h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our Beekite Family Village Kitesurf Station Praia do Macapa Macapa is located directly at the main spot and therefore directly on the beach. There is probably no better location for a kitesurf Pousada in the small and dreamy fishing village of Praia do Macapá. The Kitesurf Family Village is manned from sunrise to sunset. In 2023 we expanded our station with 11 beautiful beach chalets. Now you can finally spend the night directly on the beach and spot. </p>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-praia-do-macapa-brazil">Praia do Macapa Brazil </h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This is not possible anywhere else in Praia do Macapa Kitesurf Spot. It is best to book our Beekite Village chalets with breakfast directly through us. Our little village is located on the station area. All cottages have a small terrace and you can sleep with up to 3-4 people per chalet. We serve our breakfast, consisting of lots of fresh fruits, delicious shakes, freshly baked bread and cold cuts in our breakfast area, which was newly built in 2023. On request, you can also have breakfast on your own small terrace.</p>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-kitesurf-storage-beekite-village">Kitesurf Storage Beekite Village </h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Beekite Village kitesurf center also has a newly built, spacious storage area, so you can store your kite material directly at the spot. Annoying pumping at 35 degrees in the shade is spared thanks to the compressor.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our beach boys Pablo and Arthur will help you with starting and landing the kites from morning to night. After the kite session, you have the opportunity to wash your kite equipment on the specially created lawn with fresh water. Of course, the Beekite Village kitesurf Center also has showers and toilets. Training and rental material for the current season and brands Duotone are available in all sizes. There is a small Beach bar and Restaurant at the Beekite Brazil kitesurf station. Here you will be provided with fresh fruit shakes, açai, fruit salad and warm dishes at lunchtime.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">In the evening, our cook will be happy to prepare you catch fish, traditional picanha, fresh salads or various pasta dishes on request.</p>
<div style="height:40px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-partner">Partner</h2>
